title: The Problem with AI Sermons #shorts
description:
AI can generate text, but can it truly preach? A sermon needs to be lived, to come from the heart. Without genuine feeling, even eloquent words can't stir the soul.
#AISermons #Preaching #Faith #Heartfelt
